rows.value: one atlas child per draw section: slot = trunc(f32(hour) * N / 24.0) % N with the product and the division by the double 24.0 truncated as a double, when the section is sun-affected, else slot 0; children are never blended

rows.value: each draw call of a render section resets hasSun and scans only the node ranges submitted to it that frame; the section draws lightmap child trunc(f32(hour) * N / 24) % N when any submitted node has a front zone iZone[1] whose bSunAffect is true, else child 0; a zone without a ZoneInfo actor reads the LevelInfo (Level.Actors[0]) bSunAffect; RequiresSorting nodes are submitted one per call, so each takes its own child

rows.value: a light reaches vertex i when bit i & 7 of byte i >> 3 of its visibility bytes is set; batched instances offset i by their range start

rows.value: R = 25 * (LightRadius + 1); default 2 * b * cos(theta) with b = 2a^3 - 3a^2 + 1, a = d / R; sunlight, cylinder, non-incidence, quadratic non-incidence and spot forms per the reference notes
Steady 1, Pulse 0.6 + 0.39 sin, SubtlePulse 0.9 + 0.09 sin, Blink and Flicker per the reference notes; Strobe renders steady
hue segments split at 85 and 170 with divisor 84, saturation lerps toward white, scale 1.4 / (sqrt(1.4) + 0.01) * 0.7
lightmaps, vertex-lit meshes and terrain output c * 2 * L
time tables lerp between the bracketing rows T_i <= h < T_i+1; outside the span the last row holds; wrap is open; L2FogInfo hour colours wrap
rows.runtimeDefault: bracketing lerp, last row outside the span

rows.value: fog is enabled only when the camera ZoneInfo has bDistanceFog (+0x3d8 & 8) and the viewport actor +0x5ac & 0x80000 (assumed set, fog.viewport-actor-enable-flag), so a colour source without a known camera zone is unresolved; then a physics volume with its fog flag sets fog directly; else a non-empty local L2FogInfo list blends over the Env.int [FOG] preset in grey 127; else with an empty list a ZoneInfo with bTerrainZone takes the Env.int haze colour at the hour over the Env.int preset; else ZoneInfo DistanceFog is the fallback; alpha never gates enable
rows.provenance: Q12 replay-verified l2foginfo-runtime.json 77cffb57...c465 (replay wf_649f1c1e-7a8): FLevelSceneNode::Render 0x1065e940; RM-4 replay-verified fog-draw-scope.json b93571c0...c2ee4: exclusive setters 0x1065f96a and 0x1065f9ba, the 15_22 terrain zone case (HazeringColor 188,203,224 at 8192 to 20480 equals the RM-1 enabled call); enable = ZoneInfo+0x3d8 & 8 AND viewport actor +0x5ac & 0x80000, a separate argument from colour; reading the ZoneInfo +0x3d8 bits 0x04 and 0x08 as bTerrainZone and bDistanceFog is not re-derived
rows.runtimeDefault: enable by zone bDistanceFog, then volume, then local fog list, then terrain zone haze, then zone distance fog
